metadata.title: Grand Responsive Universe Theory (GRUT) v5.0 — Program Record: The Constitutive-Relational Framework, Books I–X (Working Edition), and the RAI Audit Infrastructure
metadata.description:
This version supersedes the earlier releases under this concept DOI. The v4.0 preprint ("The Emergence of Everything — Candidate Framework") presented GRUT as a candidate theory of everything. This release retires that framing and does not inherit the earlier lineage's numbers. What follows is the from-scratch rebuild under the GRUT v5 Build Charter: every claim machine-audited, tiered, sourced, falsifiable, and priced in a signed assumption ledger. Where the two lineages disagree, this record — with its sources and falsifiers — is the one the program stands behind, at exactly the stated strength and no higher.

What GRUT is. The Grand Responsive Universe Theory is a constitutive-relational framework built on a single standable stance: the gravitational vacuum is treated as a responsive medium — described through retarded response kernels and noise kernels in one in-in (Schwinger–Keldysh) influence-functional architecture, constrained by causality (Kramers–Kronig), equilibrium detailed balance (KMS/fluctuation-dissipation), passivity, and noise positivity. The commitment is not "responsiveness explains everything." It is the discipline of marking, ruthlessly, where responsiveness is shown versus merely assumed. The win condition is a short, honestly marked input list — not zero inputs, and not a completed theory of everything.

The Books (Working Edition). Books I–X present the program as one readable corpus: foundations and declared primitives (I); the constitutive mathematics (II); quantum mechanics (III); gravity and spacetime response (IV); memory, thermodynamics, and time (V); cosmology (VI); the matter/Standard-Model interface (VII); emergence, observation, and relational structure (VIII); tests and predictions (IX); and GRUT as a research program (X). Every substantive claim carries its epistemic status inline — DERIVED, RECOVERED, ASSUMPTION, HYPOTHESIS, UNRESOLVED, CLOSED, UNMAPPED, or REVERSED — governed by a corpus charter and a canonical status table that holds all ten books to a single vocabulary. Where the record is silent, the books say so: an absence map is treated as valid scientific content. Markdown files are the authoritative sources; the PDFs are generated from them.

The RAI layer. RAI is the program's auditing and research infrastructure — adversarial multi-agent instruments with pre-registered questions and executable verification gates, kept scientifically distinct from GRUT itself (GRUT = the theory/framework; RAI = the machinery that tests it). The five instrument records included here are the audits that stress-tested — and in several cases refuted — the program's own founding claims. The corpus itself passed an adversarial cross-audit before this release.

Twelve key points of this release:

  1. The reframing is the headline. The theory-of-everything claim is retired; GRUT v5 is a constitutive-relational framework with declared, priced primitives — and the release says exactly what changed and why.
  2. One organizing language across sectors. A single influence-functional architecture, one KMS/FDT lock, and one kernel bookkeeping span decoherence, dissipation and noise, gravitational response, cosmological response, and gravitational-wave friction — phenomena normally carried in separate formalisms.
  3. Every assumption is declared and priced. A 74-node machine-audited claims register with a signed assumption ledger is the technical baseline; its SHA-256 hash is printed in the release manifest and it was read-only to the entire book-writing process.
  4. Epistemic status labeling is structural, not a disclaimer. Statuses sit inline at each claim; a 24-entry canonical table kept ten independently drafted books at zero cross-book status drift (audit-verified).
  5. Derived results, at declared scope: the one-loop transverse-traceless response kernel with its first-order-in-H absorptive correction vanishing identically (H¹ = 0), together with a genuinely new even-degree cancellation identity behind it; a spectral law s = 5 at flat scope that rejects the framework's own earlier registered s = 3; and the exact de Sitter constant response tail H²/4π.
  6. A linear-universe response no-go: the program's RRT arm proved its intervention-response reducibility for all linear dynamics — invertible or not, including CPTP and Lindblad evolution — so escaping it requires nonlinearity. A negative result, stated as one.
  7. Recoveries are graded honestly. General relativity at zero-memory collapse and standard open-system structure are recoveries largely by identity — compatibility with standard physics on declared inputs, not correspondence evidence for GRUT.
  8. The framework excludes parts of itself. The trace-only modification μ = 4/3 that GRUT's own conformal coefficient naively suggests is excluded by separate-universe consistency and low-ℓ ISW; and every purely relaxational kernel in GRUT's class stays on one side of w = −1, so an observed phantom-divide crossing would falsify the whole family at once, GRUT included.
  9. A prediction-gate methodology, demonstrated end to end. The tensor-friction (Γ_T) candidate was taken through a design-first gate with a pre-registered five-outcome decision tree; the computation returned a refusal with the obstruction named, and the only parameter-free entry is ~62.7 orders of magnitude below the observational bound. The gate — not the hope — decided.
  10. The PREDICTED set is empty, and the record says so. The word "prediction" is reserved for gate-earned results; a committed stopping rule forbids inventing new foundational layers merely because the previous one failed.
  11. Reversals stay on the face of the claims. The founding finite-memory bet carries its own reversal (the examined exact de Sitter free-field case forces infinite scale-free memory — the opposite shape); temporal orientation is reduced to exactly one unexplained relative datum, consumed by every audited closure.
  12. The audit machinery ships with the theory. Five adversarial instrument records with their executable, de-pinned verification gates are part of the release — gates assert well-formedness, never which verdict passes — so the standard the claims were held to travels with the claims.

Contents (three layers): 01_PROGRAM — the frozen technical baseline (model framework, program freeze and stopping rule, the Γ_T prediction gate and closure computation, the signature audit, the kernel-origin audit, the claims register); 02_BOOKS — Books I–X plus the corpus charter and a reader's map, each as authoritative Markdown with a generated PDF; 03_RAI — the five instrument records and their verification scripts. A versioned MANIFEST lists all 45 files with per-file SHA-256 checksums and the authority rules. New readers should start with the Reader's Map, then Book I. Source repository: github.com/ryangrvr/GRUT-RAI (branch v4, tag zenodo-v1.0).

Working-edition statement. This is a working scientific document, not a publication claim: a structured first draft built from the frozen record under a standing directive — no invented derivations, no hypothesis-to-prediction promotion, no reopened gates, no new foundational generations — then cross-audited and repaired before release. The release itself was a publishing pass only: formatting, navigation, and metadata; no scientific substance was changed in preparation. The books were drafted by the program's RAI builder agent (Claude, Anthropic) from the frozen record under the author's direction, and that provenance is disclosed in the corpus itself.
